resources.string: Opens the device\'s native Android settings — the way in to Developer options to re-enable ADB.
Check the release channel and install newer builds. Off by default; nothing is fetched until enabled.
Read this device\'s settings from a remote template and keep them in sync. When on, every setting below is greyed out and driven by the template — only this switch and the URL stay local.
The same /state URL as the dashboard — its template carries the settings. Shared with Display, and editable here even while template control is on.
Template control is on — these settings are locked. Turn it off under Template control to edit them on the device.
Show a remote dashboard on the kiosk. Off by default; nothing is fetched until enabled and a URL is set.
Let dashboard light widgets send toggle and brightness commands. Off by default; no commands are sent until enabled and a URL is set.
Play synchronized multi-room audio from a Snapcast server. Off by default; nothing connects until enabled and a server is set.
Let the Snapcast server set this device\'s music volume, and report volume changes made here back to it. Off by default; uses the server\'s control port.
This integration is early and subject to change. Plain TCP only — no TLS or authentication.
Listen on-device for a wake word. Off by default; the microphone is only opened while this is on. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
Lower the threshold to trigger more easily, at the cost of more false alarms.
Microphone access is needed to listen for the wake word.
